title: clear reaches the presentation layer as one command, in script order
why: clear exists to replace a run of `actor id=… show=false` lines — one per character on stage — with a single command. That only pays off if it arrives at the renderer as ONE op: a compiler that helpfully expanded it back into per-actor hides would give the author shorter source and the runtime the same work, and the two runtimes would be free to expand it differently.
